summary: Independent review of the single authoritative known-defect regression watch, which replaces my merged ops/health/regression_watch.py (#956). I recommended deleting my own module on two conditions and verified both are carried across. (1) recurred must be present AND boolean: validate_readings uses 'type(row.recurred) is not bool', which is stricter than the isinstance check I asked for and correctly refuses recurred=1, since isinstance(True, int) is True in Python. (2) The explicit UNARMED row survives: static_readings() emits a row for every UNARMED catalog entry carrying its recurrence_shape, so a defect whose recurrence we cannot state says so instead of being omitted. Mutation matrix, 7 mutations, 6 turned the covering tests RED: weakening the bool check to isinstance(int) => RED (2 tests); UNARMED static row reported as OBSERVED_CLEAN => RED; re-adding a second watch module at ops/health/regression_watch.py => RED; a 'curl' constant in the Python watch => RED; a direct ntfy.sh call appended to the cron wrapper => RED; failed_evidence_readings returning OBSERVED_CLEAN instead of COULD_NOT_TELL => RED (3 tests). The last of these is the property that matters most, since a watch that fails to a false clean is worse than no watch. One mutation SURVIVED: deleting the metric-set/type validation inside _query_database (set(parsed) != expected or non-int values) changes no test, because _query_database is only ever exercised with a well-formed payload. That guard is written-never-run. It is a fail-closed check on our own psql output and is not a merge blocker, but it should get a malformed-payload test. I also record that my first mutation of that site was mis-targeted: I named the malformed-collector test, which exercises validate_readings, a different mechanism entirely. Two further mutations of mine were mis-targeted before I read the covering assertions (an smtplib import does not violate the no-second-route test, which guards curl/ntfy.sh invocation). Gate checks: base is an ancestor of head, so no rebase is needed. Diff versus base is additive apart from the intended deletion of regression_watch.py and its 56 tests; no other doc or board rows were touched. The seed-exposure fix from #956 (select_newest_own_event in scripts/seed_exposure_detector.py, which scans back 50 stream entries for our own isolated_bot_state rather than reading only the head) is untouched by this PR and survives in main; I verified it by grep rather than trusting the description. Controlled pair, full unit suite, compared as sorted failure-NAME sets rather than counts: base 4043418c 46 failed / 3769 passed, head 3f7c21a 46 failed / 3755 passed, identical 46 names, zero new failures. The names are the known macOS host-tooling baseline (missing /usr/bin/sha256sum). The -14 passing delta initially did not reconcile against my assumption that the removed file held 12 tests; I had inferred that from its 120-line diff. Collecting both files directly showed the old file held 56 parametrized tests and the new one holds 42, giving 3815 - 56 + 42 = 3801, which matches head's collection exactly. I also had to discard a first controlled pair: the worktrees ran a Python without pytest and reported new_failures=0, a false clean from a broken harness. The repo venv's .pth additionally hardcodes the main checkout's src, so I pinned PYTHONPATH per worktree and asserted each side imported its own project_mai_tai before trusting any count. Operator rulings verified as enforced rather than merely described: no second delivery route (delivery.NTFY_URL pinned to the INC1 topic, ast-level refusal of a curl constant, regex refusal of curl/ntfy.sh in the wrapper) and one authoritative watch (test asserts regression_watch.py does not exist). Installer writes only its own /etc/cron.d file, never rewrites the shared crontab, refuses a schedule that is not byte-identical to the reviewed source, installs mode 0644 rather than relying on a hand-chmod, and byte-compares after install. Wrapper enforces the ET window itself via TZ=America/New_York because CRON_TZ is ignored on the production host, and uses 10# radix prefixes so 0350 is not read as octal. Catalog is 17 rows, 8 ARMED, 4 DELEGATED, 5 UNARMED, and the doc states each row's benign and recurrence polarity plainly. Scope gap I am recording rather than blocking on: neither of this week's two fixes has a watch row. #955 (the fresh-SELL latch clear whose absence suppressed the TNON entry) and #960 (the 3-consecutive-sub-floor-bar volume pull) are replay-proven only and face live money for the first time on Monday, so they are exactly the defects most likely to recur unobserved. Both have stateable discriminators ([V2-RESTING-SLOT-CONSUMED] reason=first_slot_already_consumed on a fresh flip; a resting cancel with fewer than 3 sub-floor bars). Requested as a follow-up PR. CI: validate passed twice on this head.
